Results.ReviewText: I have owned a variety of outdoor grills over the years and the Spirit E-310 is by far the best in regards to cooking grilling capability,  ease of maintenance, and overall design. If you are looking for the most bang for your buck this is the unit to buy. This 3-burner model heats up quickly and cooks steaks, burgers, kabobs, and more to your satisfaction. Clean-up is a breeze! Couldn’t be happier with my grill!

Results.Title: As good as Genesis!

Results.ReviewText:
I’m pleased with my E-310 grill. It heats quickly and evenly. The cast iron grates are a big improvement over the grates in my old Weber. There are two issues that I think should be mentioned, however.
1. It is extremely difficult to install the propane tank on the weight gauge. It’s an awkward place, and lifting a full tank to hang it on the gauge is a physically demanding task as you need to kneel and use only your arms to place the tank.
2. The heat control knobs need to have more distinct markings. In less than full light, it is difficult to ascertain where the “pointer” on the knob is located. It is merely a slightly raised ridge on the outer edge of the knob. A contrasting color marking on the knobs would be beneficial.
Despite these issues, I recommend the E-310 but deducted one star because of them.
Results.Title: Recommend the E-310

Results.ReviewText: I got the Weber Spirit II grill on May 14.  The regulator broke on June 6th.  I contacted Weber on June 6th, so far no response other than auto email reply.  Now my choice is to go buy a replacement regulator or wait until someone at Weber answers my warranty claim.  Either way it is extremely inconvenient .  Sucks, i have a nice expensive grill sitting on the patio i can't use.

Results.ReviewText: Have had this model for awhile and I find it to be very good. Cooking is even and except for putting the tank in, it is easy to use. I am over 70 and getting the tank hooked up is a chore.

Results.ReviewText: Poor design the way the tank is mounted. It is extremely difficult to place the tank on the mount. Also we had to replace the hose with the regulator on Saturday June 6 due to a leak around the regulator. They gave me a replacement and when I opened the tank valve to use the grill tonight the replacement hose is leaking at the same place. We are very disappointed. The Weber grill I had previously was 17 years old and other than replacing grates and flavor bars I did nothing else to it. Your quality in grills has declined tremendously.
Results.Title: Disappointed

Results.ReviewText: Best grill I ever purchased. Great company!!! Heat is even from front to back of grill. No HOT spots. Had a small burner issue and it was resolved ASAP. Would and have told many about what a great company and great customer services advocates tgey have workong for them.

Results.ReviewText: This grill isn't the cheapest, but I learned years ago to stay with Weber.  My last one lasted about 15 years and always worked...even the igniter lasted.  This one will grill anything that the average patio party wants....I would suggest buying the cover and using it when the grill is not in use.

Results.ReviewText: The Weber Spirit 310 is an excellent hard grill.  The 3 burners heat up very quickly and cook all foods evenly.  I would recommend this grill to anyone.

46510001.Name: Spirit E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
46510001.Description:
Add flavor to the menu with a Spirit E-310. It’s the ideal grill for entertaining a small crowd or a perfect solution to any family meal. Place serving trays and spices on the side tables so that everything you need is where you are, when you need it. With features such as porcelain-enameled, cast-iron cooking grates that retain even heat, you’re guaranteed the best tasting food. It’s built to last with a cookbox that helps prevent rusting and peeling, and conveniently equipped with six tool hooks for easy accessibility of grilling tools. If that wasn’t enough, the low maintenance and easy-to-clean grease management system takes the hassle out of cooking.


• Durable, easy-to-clean porcelain-enamel cast iron grates.

• Porcelain-enameled finish helps prevent rusting and pealing.

• Six tool hooks for easy accessibility of grilling tools.

• Low maintenance and easy-to-clean grease management system.

• 424 square inches of main grilling space.


 This product requires assembly.
